messages:
anya_partnerships: Pilot proposal: 'SI Satellite' onboarding for small SIs in APAC/EU. 4-week cohort to enable marketplace listing + basic HW install support. Low-touch, repeatable. Thoughts? :globe_with_meridians:

devon_solutions: Agree. Cohort-based to batch resources.

kelly_ops: Logistics: APAC customs ~10 days. Recommend digital-first labs + optional HW voucher.

chris_sales: GTM: one short partner announcement per cohort. Marketing needs quote/logo 3w prior.

sam_lewis: Ops checklist: create sandbox org, 12 seats, upload AMIs, share terraform demo. Need participant emails.

anya_partnerships: Voucher + 30-min cert + badge needed. Ill publish signup form Monday.

marketplace-bot: Listing checklist: quickstart, catalog-image, pricing flag. Internal link posted.

kelly_ops: Ill open procurement issue for voucher infra. ETA 5bd.

devon_solutions: Curriculum draft: wk0 onboarding, wk1 deploy & pin, wk2 observability, wk3 troubleshooting + cert. Each week: 2h live + labs.

anya_partnerships: Action items assigned. Next sync after signup opens. :rocket:
